checks.test: Viewer uses outer camera, not private filmed camera
Looking at the screen qualifies
Brief glance does not start construction
Dwell starts playback
Looking away freezes timeline without catching up
Unwatched feed stops rendering
Looking back resumes from the held moment
Looking back respects manual pause
Manual changes get a frame even while paused
Paused feed stops after its requested refresh
Looking above the screen does not qualify
Rear of monitor cannot trigger it
Distant screen does not trigger it
Screen can be watched from an oblique angle
A solid wall blocks gaze activation
Removing obstruction allows viewing again
Hidden monitor cannot activate
Moved and rotated monitors use their actual screen plane
Synthetic XR camera is selected and can trigger the screen
Synthetic headset turn leaves the screen
Live callbacks run while watched
Live callbacks freeze during a sustained look away
Rendered screen holds exactly the same pixels while unwatched
Rendered feed refreshes after returning to look

scope: Desktop runtime and synthetic XRCamera3D; physical headset not tested.
